ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Heat and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of heat in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dangers of heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
